newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS COMPONENT/CHIP EARNINGS PICK UP.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS COMPONENT/CHIP EARNINGS PICK UP.

text.p: Sales of Philips Electronics NV's components and semiconductors sector showed three percent growth over the first half of 1997 compared to the year-ago period, Philips said on Thursday.
Sales in the components and semiconductor division amounted to 8.9 billion guilders in the first half of 1997 versus 7.8 billion guilders in the year ago period.
Operating profits for the division rose to 1.06 billion guilders from 908 million in the first six months of 1996.
The increase was largely related to higher semiconductor activities, Philips said.
Second-quarter operating profits rose to 630 million guilders from 429 million guilders in the first quarter of 1997.

Philips said sales growth for components had been moderate, adding that sales of semiconductors had accelerated in the second quarter, particularly those used in consumer products, communications and multimedia applications.
